# 關於此繁體中文資源包：
本資源包支援模組**Distant Horizons**（非官方譯名：**遙遠的地平線**）\
自2024年6月8日（GMT+8）發布2.1.0-alpha版本以來的所有版本（實際項目啟動時間更早）\
涵蓋**Minecraft 1.16.5及以上所有版本** \
由Bilibili用戶[ConfectionaryQwQ (UID:694203513)](https://space.bilibili.com/694203513)與[在摸魚的天本 (UID:636174072)](https://space.bilibili.com/636174072)共同翻譯\
本資源包至今已有**超過一年的歷史**，近期應廣大玩家要求上傳至Modrinth平台，
本人自模組2.1.0-a、2.2.0-a、2.3.0-b等大版本更新以來，一直持續發布更新。
本資源包的翻譯內容也已參與**I18nUpdateMod自動翻譯更新模組Ⅲ**的維護專案，
遺憾的是，儘管早在2024年4月13日於**I18nUpdateMod自動翻譯更新模組Ⅲ**的
[Github倉庫](https://github.com/CFPAOrg/Minecraft-Mod-Language-Package) 
發起[Pull Request](https://github.com/CFPAOrg/Minecraft-Mod-Language-Package/pull/5171)，**至今仍未獲通過**，包括本專案，**總計6個**針對 
**Distant Horizons**（非官方譯名：**遙遠的地平線**）模組發起的Pull Request **均未通過**。 

# 為什麼"Distant Horizons"的非官方譯名是"遙遠的地平線"?
"**遙遠的地平線**"是經騰訊頻道[Minecraft圖形學社群 | MGC](https://pd.qq.com/s/h841609va)**社群管理員**和**成員**一致討論後的結果，在拋棄諸多命名廢案之後選擇的結果，參照**劍橋詞典**，"Distant"譯為"遙遠的"，"Horizon"譯為"地平線"，即使模組名稱是"Horizons"而非"Horizon"，"Horizons"如果翻譯為"視野"或者"眼界"實在欠妥，
地平線就是視野的盡頭，"地平線"這個翻譯顯然更具美感，遊戲內的"視野"指的是"FOV(可視角度)"而非"可視距離"，"可視距離"一般被稱為"視距"，並且"Horizon"在其他遊戲中也有被翻譯成"地平線"的案例，比如微軟賽車遊戲 **《Forza Horizon 4》**，**《Forza Horizon 5》**。最後，**Distant Horizons**的作者Discord社群頻道聽過中文對於"Horizons"的翻譯，並且表達過對此翻譯的喜愛。(雖然此說法至今已無從考證，但依舊不能否認"地平線"一詞翻譯的信達雅之處)。

# 為什麼Distant Horizons 遙遠的地平線 官方不加入多語言支援?
1.早在**2024年6月13日**，**Distant Horizons 遙遠的地平線**官方**Discord**社群的#**progress-update**頻道就有提及 \
計劃創建**Crowdin**站點，並在**Discord**頻道添加**翻譯機器人**、**頻道**以及**身份組**，**但至今杳無音訊**。 \
2.本人也在2024年12月05日詢問過何時創建**Crowdin**站點，答覆是"等到一切都不再有較大的改變， \
也許等到**Beta**或者**Release**階段之後再做打算"，Distant Horizons 遙遠的地平線模組已於**2024年11月17**進入**Beta**階段 \
**Release**階段**依舊遙遙無期**。
# 為什麼選擇此繁體中文資源包:
此繁體中文資源包花費了本人不知多少個小時的時間製作，經過長時間的校對，廣大玩家反饋和意見，本人尚且認為此繁體中文資源包已經**非常完善**，**翻譯內容量達到100%**，**並且更新非常及時**。
無論是2.1.0-a、2.2.0-a、2.3.0-b大版本更新亦或是小版本更新，繁體中文資源包都會在不久後發布在**本人的網盤**或者是**Distant Horizons中文討論組QQ群**，同時本人會發布**B站動態**和**群公告**以告知廣大玩家及時更新。\
另外，本資源包也並非完美無瑕，如果你有異議或者更好的翻譯，歡迎在B站私訊我或者在我B站的影片評論區發表評論。
# About This Traditional Chinese Localization Resource Pack:  
This resource pack supports the mod **Distant Horizons** (unofficially named **遙遠的地平線**).  
It has been developed for all versions released since **June 8, 2024 (GMT+8)**, starting from version **2.1.0-alpha** (though the project began earlier).  
It covers **all Minecraft versions from 1.16.5 onwards**.  

Translated collaboratively by Bilibili users [ConfectionaryQwQ (UID: 694203513)](https://space.bilibili.com/694203513) and [在摸魚的天本 (UID: 636174072)](https://space.bilibili.com/636174072).  
This resource pack has **over a year of history** and has recently been uploaded to the Modrinth platform in response to player requests.  

Since the major updates of **2.1.0-a**, **2.2.0-a**, and **2.3.0-b**, I have consistently released updates.  
The translations in this resource pack have also been contributed to the maintenance project of **I18nUpdateMod Auto Localization Update Mod Ⅲ**.  

Unfortunately, despite submitting a [Pull Request](https://github.com/CFPAOrg/Minecraft-Mod-Language-Package/pull/5171) to the [Github repository](https://github.com/CFPAOrg/Minecraft-Mod-Language-Package) of **I18nUpdateMod Auto Localization Update Mod Ⅲ** as early as **April 13, 2024**, it **has yet to be approved**. Including this project, **a total of 6 Pull Requests** for the **Distant Horizons** mod (unofficially named **遙遠的地平線**) **remain unmerged**.  

---

# Why is the Unofficial Translation of "Distant Horizons" "遙遠的地平線"?  
"**遙遠的地平線**" was chosen after extensive discussion among **community administrators** and **members** of the Tencent channel [Minecraft Graphics Community | MGC](https://pd.qq.com/s/h841609va). After discarding many alternative names, this translation was selected based on the **Cambridge Dictionary**:  
- "Distant" translates to "遙遠的" (distant).  
- "Horizon" translates to "地平線" (horizon).  

Although the mod name uses "Horizons" instead of "Horizon," translating "Horizons" as "視野" (field of view) or "眼界" (perspective) was deemed inappropriate.  
The horizon represents the limit of one's vision, and "地平線" carries a more poetic and aesthetic nuance. In-game, "視野" typically refers to "FOV (field of view)" rather than "view distance," which is commonly called "視距."  

Additionally, "Horizon" has been translated as "地平線" in other games, such as Microsoft's racing games **《Forza Horizon 4》** and **《Forza Horizon 5》**.  
Finally, the author of **Distant Horizons** has expressed appreciation for this Chinese translation in the Discord community (though this claim can no longer be verified, the elegance and accuracy of "地平線" remain undeniable).  

---

# Why Doesn’t Distant Horizons Officially Support Multiple Languages?  
1. As early as **June 13, 2024**, the official **Distant Horizons** Discord community mentioned in the **#progress-update** channel plans to create a **Crowdin** site, add a **translation bot**, and establish dedicated **channels** and **roles**. However, **there has been no progress since**.  
2. On **December 5, 2024**, I inquired about the timeline for creating the Crowdin site. The response was: "We’ll consider it once everything stabilizes, perhaps during the **Beta** or **Release** phase." The mod entered the **Beta** phase on **November 17, 2024**, but the **Release** phase **remains uncertain**.  

---

# Why Choose This Localization Resource Pack?  
This resource pack represents countless hours of work, extensive proofreading, and incorporates feedback and suggestions from players. I believe it is **highly refined**, with **100% translation coverage**, and **updated promptly**.  
Whether for major updates like **2.1.0-a**, **2.2.0-a**, and **2.3.0-b** or minor patches, the localized resource pack is always released shortly afterward on **my personal cloud storage** or the **Distant Horizons Chinese Discussion QQ Group**. I also announce updates via **Bilibili posts** and **group notifications** to keep players informed.
